rv.q: Mindell’s play often feels like one of those ill-fated kitchen endeavors

On the Evolutionary Function of Shame is a master class in weaving topical issues with people and stories that humanize those issues. And in a world that is actively trying to remove trans people from society, to see a play like this one is truly special, and no small privilege.
...its message remains undeniable: there is beauty in difference
Though it’s hardly a brief outcry, it lands as insufficient
...a smorgasbord of ideas that will accompany you for a long, long time.

On the whole, Mindell has created something original — a thought exercise where serious issues get a real workout.
